text:
maya: Heads-up — just ran a nightly smoke on q4b-prod (quantized bridge) and saw a spike in embedding distance on the longtail promptset. baseline avg cosine = 0.78, q4b avg = 0.61.
liam: ugh. did the deploy go out in the last window?
deploy-bot: deploy completed by ci/cd at 1769994000 — service: redwood-inference-q4b, version: q4b-2026-03-01-ff12
sasha: can you paste the diff of failing cases? short list is fine.
maya: adding quick sample. these are from the holdout promptbank (seed: longtail-2026-02)
maya: ```
# curl to reproduce
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"q4b-bridge","input":["how do i reset my router password?","symptoms: shortness of breath after climbing stairs"]}'
# baseline embeddings (cosine between pair) ~ 0.68
# q4b embeddings ~ 0.45
```
jun: labelers can run a quick sanity check if you give a remapped sample set. how many do we need?
maya: starting diff dump now. think 200 high-delta examples will surface tokenization edgecases and deid noise.
olivia: fwiw, our eval harness shows tokenization boundary shifts often explain >0.1 cosine drift on long prompts. run tokenizer-viz on a few.
liam: if tokenizer drift is the cause, maybe the quantized kernel changed byte-level handling? any evidence in logs?
maya: saw warnings in runtime log around 1769994012 about fallback to fast-tokenizer: `warn: tokenizer fallback to C++ fastpath (incompatible vocab table)`. attached snippet: ```warn: vocab-table mismatch for model q4b-2026-03-01, using fallback fast-tokenizer which normalizes unknown bytes differently```
sasha: that message rings a bell — earlier patch swapped in a trimmed vocab for memory savings. could cause rare normalization differences.
liam: we can route traffic to q4b-2026-02 for affected customers with a routing rule until we patch. set policy: region=us-west, latency_SLO unaffected.
maya: agree. let's do detection + routing as quick mitigation. proposal:
1) run an AB on 1k prompts (stratified: 200 longtail, 800 random) comparing q4b-2026-02 vs q4b-2026-03
2) ask labelers to relabel top-200 deltas for golden refresh
3) if tokenizer mismatch confirmed, patch tokenizers + rebuild quant kernels
4) smart-route longtail -> older model until verified

liam: I'll open a routing ticket and a rollback toggle. can we get the AB script?
olivia: prepping AB harness now — will include tokenization diff, avg cosine, and downstream rerank delta. small snippet: ```python
# pseudocode
for prompt in prompts:
  e_old = embed(old_model, prompt)
  e_new = embed(new_model, prompt)
  cos = cosine(e_old, e_new)
  tok_old = tokenize(old_model.tokenizer, prompt)
  tok_new = tokenize(new_model.tokenizer, prompt)
  emit(prompt, cos, tok_old, tok_new)
```
jun: can label ops turn around 200 relabels in 48h? we can prioritize with "expedite" queue. need manifest + microinstructions.
sasha: i'll generate the manifest and microinstructions (what counts as "same intent", edgecases). will include examples where tokenization merges punctuation differently.
maya: manifest prep started — sending sample CSV to #label-ops in 5m.
liam: routing ticket created: RT-4821. If we switch route, what's the expected perf hit?
maya: negligible, older model still within latency SLO. main downside is slightly higher cost per token.
olivia: AB harness will produce p95/p50 latency, cosine mean/stdev, and a rerank precision@10 delta. expect results in ~3 hours for 1k run on dedicated bench.
jun: label-ops: we can take expedited 200, ETA 36h with two labelers, will add to queue once manifest posted.
sasha: microinstructions posted -> https://internal.redwood/labeling/micro/golden-tokenizer-edgecases (private). :memo:
maya: running AB now. kicking off with batch id ab-176999. posting logs here when done.
liam: thumbs up. also flagging infra to check tokenizer artifact pipeline — might be a build step that pruned vocab entries during quant build.
olivia: if AB shows tokenization mismatch correlates with cosine <0.6, we have a smoking gun. else we inspect quantization noise on attention heads.
maya: AB complete early — summary: 1k prompts
- avg cosine (old vs old baseline): 0.79
- avg cosine (old -> new): 0.62
- 187/1000 prompts below 0.6
- tokenization mismatches present in 152 of those 187
attached full CSV (uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-ci/ab/ab-176999/results.csv)
jun: ok that's... mostly tokenizer. pushing expedite relabel job.
sasha: starting golden refresh plan: will replace 150 examples in microgolden set and mark 50 as 'needs tokenizer fix' for developer follow-up.
liam: infra action: revert-pr-quant-token-trim assigned to @infra-ops, block until vocab rebuild. RT-4821 will route longtail traffic meanwhile.
maya: thanks everyone. follow-ups:
- sasha to post manifest + updated golden set items (today)
- jun to confirm relabel job enqueued (within 1h)
- liam to enable routing rule (now) and track rollback toggle
- olivia to produce final AB report with plots and token diffs (by EOD)

olivia: initial report posted -> https://internal.redwood/ab-reports/ab-176999 (includes token-diff heatmap)
sasha: manifest link: https://internal.redwood/label-manifests/176999-longtail-tokenizer.csv
jun: relabel job ID RL-9001 created, ETA 34h. tagging label-ops for visibility.
liam: routing rule enabled: longtail->q4b-2026-02 for customer cohort `promptsource:longtail` — monitoring.
maya: closing loop: we'll coordinate patch + rebuild kernel once vocab rebuild completes. thanks all :heart:
